purpose: Host-side, deterministic semantic state observation and requested posture for the Sims 4 bottom-right HUD, avoiding repeated model screenshot interpretation.

states.COLLAPSED: This module is not visibly open; independent other-panel state unknown.
states.CONDENSED: Open from minimum through any intermediate height below maximum.
states.EXPANDED: Open at measured maximum or within 3 percent of maximum.
states.UNKNOWN: Image, cue identity, geometry, mode, patch or other required proof is unverified.

dimensions.panel_id: Canonical semantic module name (owned by ui_microsystems), independent of visibility.
dimensions.expansion: Continuous normalized [0,1] within calibrated min/max; cannot infer item scroll.
dimensions.inventory_scroll: UNKNOWN until an independent scrollbar/content sensor provides it.
dimensions.selected_sim: UNKNOWN from these HUD pixel anchors; active Sim requires native/host identity.
dimensions.ownership: HOST | OPERATOR | UNKNOWN; only explicitly host-owned panels can be proposed for mutation.
dimensions.current_visible_panel_id: A separate verified focus signal. Do not assume that no inventory panel means no other panel.

inventory_sensor.source: Eight user-supplied paused Sims screenshots, 2026-11-14. Images used for local evaluation, not stored in repository.
inventory_sensor.title_band: Blue Filter Items... text 1520<=x<1660, 180<=y<880; blue row count >=40; header y = best_y-30
inventory_sensor.sell_band: Blue Drag here to sell text 1640<=x<1800, 965<=y<1020; blue row count >=50
inventory_sensor.note: Not an invariant of other DLC themes, UI scales, resolution profiles or non-inventory panels.

module_namespace_source: contracts/ui-microsystems.v1.json, plus existing ui_chrome bottom-right panel hotkeys
mandatory_gates: Operator idle, panel host-owned, fresh game scene, fresh selected-Sim identity
No current different panel observed; preserve operator-selected UI
Use existing ui_chrome hotkey catalog for open/close only after separate effect admission
Use calibrated fixed_ui_click_map/screen_atlas grip for resize only; unknown hitbox blocks
Use existing CooperativeScreenQueue and player-presence lease for any future effect
Reobserve panel after any admitted one-effect request before another
Never conflate panel resize with internal scrollbar traversal
Preserve paused sleep interaction, queued intent, saves, OS peripherals

acceptance.probe_results: Eight out of eight supplied frames matched on host-side offline detector. Not a live game effect.
negative_cases: unknown selected Sim or stale scene
